title: [TEST] Configuring Smart Tips, Beacons, Launchers, and Blockers (live demo)
html_content:
To configure a Smart Tip, Beacon, Launcher, or Blocker, open the relevant flow and switch to the Widgets tab, which is separate from your flow's Content tab. All widget types are managed from the Widgets tab.

Once you've selected the widget type under the Widgets tab, configure its trigger conditions as usual.
